pkgmetadata.longdescription: omlx is an LLM inference server built on MLX, featuring continuous batching and SSD caching. It supports a wide range of model architectures including language, vision-language, and embedding models, and provides an OpenAI-compatible API server backed by FastAPI and uvicorn.
